name: @mnemosyne-plugins/mnemo-archipel
description: Un CRM personnel organique et sobre conçu pour le TDAH, luttant contre l'oubli des relations par la résonance cognitive.

descriptionI18n.fr: Un CRM personnel organique et sobre conçu pour le TDAH, luttant contre l'oubli des relations par la résonance cognitive.
descriptionI18n.en: An organic, understated personal CRM designed for ADHD, fighting the forgetting of relationships through cognitive resonance.
descriptionI18n.es: Un CRM personal orgánico y sobrio diseñado para el TDAH, que combate el olvido de las relaciones mediante la resonancia cognitiva.

_permissions: vault:read and vault:write keep each contact in this app's own sandbox vault. model:infer reads a brain dump to extract facts. agenda:write puts a follow-up you chose into the Mnemosyne Agenda, on a press, so it rings with this window closed; it cannot read, move or delete an appointment.

agentActions.summary: List or search the people in the Archipel: id, name, relations, warmth, last contact, email, phone, number of facts and open tasks.
agentActions.details: query matches every word in the name, relations, facts, email or phone, accents ignored. Sorted by name.

query.description: Words to look for; empty = everyone.

agentActions.summary: One person in full: facts, tasks, important dates and the latest mementos.
agentActions.details: mementos holds the 20 newest; mementosNotShown counts the rest.

contactId.description: The person by their id from contacts, or by their name as said (« Léa », « Léa Martin »).

agentActions.summary: Show one person's page on the person's screen.

contactId.description: The person by their id from contacts, or by their name as said (« Léa », « Léa Martin »).

agentActions.summary: Add a person to the Archipel, as the New contact form does, then show their page.
agentActions.details: relations: a key (Friend, Colleague, Family, Mentor, or one of the person's own categories) or the word said (« famille », « amis »); an unknown one is refused with the names (NO_RELATION).

relations.description: Relations, by key or as said.

agentActions.summary: Add a fact about a person (what they like, their job, their kids' names...), shown on their page.

contactId.description: The person by their id from contacts, or by their name as said (« Léa », « Léa Martin »).

agentActions.summary: Record that the person was in touch with someone today, as the Record a contact button does: warmth goes up and a memento is kept.

contactId.description: The person by their id from contacts, or by their name as said (« Léa », « Léa Martin »).

agentActions.summary: Add a task about a person (call back, send the photos...) to their tasks.
agentActions.details: No reminder date: putting a reminder in the Agenda stays a gesture of the person, on the task.

contactId.description: The person by their id from contacts, or by their name as said (« Léa », « Léa Martin »).

agentActions.summary: Tick a person's task as done (or not done).
agentActions.details: Calling it twice does not flip it back.

contactId.description: The person by their id from contacts, or by their name as said (« Léa », « Léa Martin »).

taskId.description: The task id from contact, or its words (« rappeler », « les photos »).

agentActions.summary: Show one of L'Archipel's screens, as the header buttons do: the dashboard, the 2D map of islands, the 3D map, the list, the timeline, or the settings.
Show only one kind of relation (friends, family, colleagues, mentors or one of the person's own categories), as the filter chips do; « all » shows everyone again.
agentActions.details: The filter acts on the dashboard and the two maps; from another screen the 2D map is shown.

relation.description: A relation key or the word said (« famille », « amis »), or « all ».

agentActions.summary: Close what is open over the screen: a person's page, a form, the profile, the reminders, a menu.
Open the reminders (the bell): the people it is time to get back to.
Change how L'Archipel looks: light or dark theme, human or magical avatars, the app's language.

language.description: auto (the system's), en, fr or es.

agentGuide: Name a person the way the person says it (« Léa », « Léa Martin »), a task by its words (« rappeler »), a relation by its word (« famille »): L'Archipel finds them. Several matches are refused with their names (AMBIGUOUS): pick one and call again.
To look at something: openContact for a person's page, showView for a screen, filterRelation to keep one kind of relation, showReminders for who to get back to, closeView to close.
« I called Léa » / « j'ai vu Léa » is recordContact. Something learned about someone is addFact; something to do for them is addTask; done is completeTask.
Nothing is deleted from here, and the brain dump and the memory search stay the person's own buttons.
